clips.title: The story
paras: A severed head found in the southern Barrens brings The Harvester’s strange presence to Camp Taurajo. Jorn Skyseer examines the remains, and the creature’s intrusion raises concerns for the land’s spiritual and ecological balance.

In the southern Barrens, you find the severed head of a silithid called the Harvester. Lions, raptors, and kodos roam these grasslands, but this chitinous insectoid is unlike the native wildlife. Its presence suggests an alien ecology has reached the open plains of Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You seemed troubled, friend. How go your lessons in the Barrens? Did you find something that disturbs you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled. But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens. I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...
But for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.
